Waking to the steady bleep of a nearby machine I reach up to wipe the sand from my eyes. As the blurriness fades from my view the darkness surrounding me becomes more apparent, a blinking red light across from flashes in time with the annoying bleep that woke me. Trying to find my bearings I look around, the glass door of my sleep pod hangs open or is possibly missing, it’s hard to tell in the minimal light. Slapping my fist against the pancake release on my harness I swear loudly as gravity ungratefully drops me onto my face, apparently our landing was less than perfect this time around.

Pressing against the cool steel floor of my landing shuttle I weakly climb back to my feet, it’s easy to forget how detrimental living without gravity can be to your muscles; until you’re thrust back into nefarious realm of physics. Groping around in the darkness, my hands lightly trailing over various pieces of machinery I finally find my target. The mechanical reset for the ships power systems, jerking it hard I smile at the satisfying click and the sudden silence – the red light also fading to nothing. Shoving forward I expect to hear the familiar sounds of machines whirring to life but instead am greeting by nothing but a red blinking light and that damned bleeping.

Going off memory I make my way to the main hatch, reaching out to feel for the solid steel walls when a sudden, fiery pain shoots through my knee as I catch the edge of a machine or table. Swearing loudly and clutching my leg I try to calm myself down and relax, ignoring the fact that my brand new planetary exploration shuttle was broken down on an unexplored planet and even the auxiliary power that is supposed to kick in during such an event, has failed. Before leaving the main ship, scans showed that this planets atmosphere could not only sustain life but was safe to breath without mechanical assistance. With any luck the scans were accurate and I won’t suffocate to death or implode upon opening the shuttle doors.

Reaching out into the darkness again, careful to avoid the sneaking assassin of a corner that got me last time I continue to inch forward until the cool metal of the walls greets my fingertips. Sighing audibly I start pawing at the door, finding the lever that controls the main hatch I jerk up hard and nothing happens. ”Oh for fucks sake..” taking a firm grip of the metal release pull again, lifting with my legs arms and back I put everything I have into it and still – no movement. “Come on you over price piece of shit!” Shaking the handle angrily, I pull and press but still nothing happens, growling deep in my chest I contemplate my situation, trying to think of what I can do next my fingers start drumming across the round surface of the handle.

Chuckling to myself I comment into the darkness, “You’re such a fucking idiot..” as I remember the hatch release used a flat handle not round. Dropping my hands a few inches I feel the short flat piece of metal, pulling up it easily moves with an audible click followed by the sound of pressurized air releasing. A cool burst of air flowed around the steadily opening seam around the door as the smell of foreign flora and damp earth quickly filled the interior of the shuttle.

As pale light flooded inside I could see the round metal lever I had been struggling with before. It was a handle, firmly bolted to the inside of the hatch; presumably to make closing easier. Shaking my head at my own stupidity as the door slowly rose up, I watched it move away revealing the night sky above. It also revealed a sea of sharp looking wood spears pointed in my direction and the moons above did a fantastic job illuminating the brownish green colored humanoids that clutched those spears.

Lifting my hand to greet my new welcome committee, I wished dearly that the door wasn’t so far away and their spears weren’t so close. “Hi everybody..” the nervousness in my voice was apparent by the way it cracked near the end, not that the inhabitants here would be able to understand me anyway.

Their looks of confusion spoke volumes as they started chattering amongst themselves. Soon they began to shuffle away from each other leaving an opening between the two groups, a short fat little creature, supporting itself on a large gnarled stick, began crutching towards me. Peering about in confusion, the many eyes of this species staring up at me as this presumably elder of their race inched his way along. Gingerly placing his foot upon the ramp that had extended with the opening door he paused for a moment, banging his stick loudly against the ramp before continuing towards me.

Starting to grow nervous and having nowhere to go I tried to make eye contact with the creature but his attention seemed focused on his own feet. Within kicking distance now I seriously considered punting this fat little man off my ship but the sea of spears assured me that I would develop exciting new orifices if I tried anything so rash. Slowly lifting his bald head to reveal small milky white orbs that passed for eyes he appeared to have no nose but instead two dark slits between his mouth and eyes. The black holes in the creatures face flared slightly before flapping loosely like old skin as the creature breathed heavily, apparently exerted from his marathon walk. Opening my mouth to speak again, the stick-like staff in the creatures right hand suddenly shot through the air. Pain exploded in my head as the large knot at the end of the stick connected with my temple. “Filthy fuck!” was all I managed to get out before stumbling forward, blackness quickly stealing my vision as I collapsed at the ugly creatures feet.
